commands.title: NX-OS version and uptime
commands.description: Show chassis, NX-OS image, BIOS, boot mode, uptime, and last reload reason.

commands.title: Hardware inventory
commands.description: List chassis, modules, power supplies, transceivers, and serial identifiers.

commands.title: Module health
commands.description: Show line-card, supervisor, fabric, and module state and diagnostics.

commands.title: Interface status table
commands.description: Show link, VLAN, duplex, speed, and transceiver type for switch ports.

commands.title: Interface details
commands.description: Inspect link state, MTU, addressing, rates, errors, and queue counters for one interface.

commands.title: Interface error counters
commands.description: Compare receive, transmit, collision, discard, and protocol error counters across ports.

commands.title: Port-channel summary
commands.description: Show aggregate state, member flags, protocols, and operational bundles.

commands.title: vPC health summary
commands.description: Show vPC peer adjacency, keepalive, consistency, peer-link, and member status.

commands.title: vPC global consistency
commands.description: Compare global Type-1 and Type-2 parameters between vPC peers.

commands.title: Spanning-tree summary
commands.description: Summarize spanning-tree mode, root roles, topology changes, and feature state.

commands.title: VLAN summary
commands.description: Show VLAN IDs, names, state, and member ports.

commands.title: MAC address table
commands.description: Display learned, static, and control-plane MAC entries with VLAN and interface.

commands.title: ARP table
commands.description: Display IPv4 neighbors, age, MAC address, and associated interface.

commands.title: IPv4 routing table
commands.description: Show installed IPv4 prefixes, administrative distance, metric, and next hop.

commands.title: BGP summary
commands.description: Summarize BGP neighbors, state, uptime, and prefix counts.

commands.title: OSPF neighbors
commands.description: Show OSPF adjacency state, dead time, neighbor ID, and interface.

commands.title: LLDP neighbor details
commands.description: Show neighboring system identity, management address, port, and capabilities.

commands.title: Recent log messages
commands.description: Read a bounded number of most recent NX-OS log messages.

commands.title: Environmental health
commands.description: Show temperature, fan, power, and environmental alarm state.

commands.title: Running configuration
commands.description: Display active configuration, which can expose infrastructure and credential material.
